controls.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data in Transit
controls.recommendation: Use only strong SSH algorithms and replace cleartext services (Telnet, FTP, HTTP) with encrypted alternatives.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
controls.recommendation: Adopt a hardened baseline (CIS Benchmark) and enforce it with configuration management.

controls.title: Configure Automatic Session Locking on Enterprise Assets
controls.recommendation: Configure idle session timeouts (SSH ClientAliveInterval/CountMax, shell TMOUT).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.recommendation: Enable a default-deny host firewall on every server.

controls.title: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services
controls.recommendation: Remove or disable unneeded network services and bind admin services to management interfaces.

controls.title: Use Unique Passwords
controls.recommendation: Enforce password complexity (minimum 14 characters) and forbid empty passwords.

controls.title: Restrict Administrator Privileges to Dedicated Administrator Accounts
controls.recommendation: Disable direct root login, remove duplicate UID 0 accounts and require authentication for sudo.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
controls.recommendation: Schedule recurring authorised vulnerability scans and track remediation SLAs.

controls.title: Perform Automated Operating System Patch Management
controls.recommendation: Enable automatic security updates or a managed patch cycle.

controls.title: Remediate Detected Vulnerabilities
controls.recommendation: Remediate critical vulnerabilities within 72 hours and high within 7 days.

controls.title: Collect Audit Logs
controls.recommendation: Enable auditd and sudo logging; forward logs to a central collector.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.recommendation: Run the CyberShield sensor (or NetFlow/IPFIX) on key network segments.

controls.title: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded
controls.recommendation: Scan all in-scope assets regularly and record findings in the risk register.

controls.title: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated
controls.recommendation: Prioritise remediation by severity and exploitability and track it to closure.

controls.title: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed
controls.recommendation: Review accounts, enforce password policy and lock unused/system accounts.

controls.title: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated
controls.recommendation: Use key-based SSH authentication and limit authentication attempts.

controls.title: Access permissions are managed, incorporating least privilege
controls.recommendation: Apply least privilege for sudo, root access and sensitive file permissions.

controls.title: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected
controls.recommendation: Encrypt all administrative and application traffic with modern protocols.

controls.title: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
controls.recommendation: Filter inbound traffic with host and network firewalls; restrict exposed services.

controls.title: Configuration management practices are established and applied
controls.recommendation: Maintain hardened configuration baselines and detect drift automatically.

controls.title: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
controls.recommendation: Patch promptly and decommission unsupported software.

controls.title: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring
controls.recommendation: Generate security logs (auditd, sudo) and centralise them.

controls.title: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
controls.recommendation: Deploy continuous passive network monitoring and investigate anomalies.

executive_summary: Overall technical compliance is 9% (critical posture). CIS Critical Security Controls v8: 15% (2 passed, 1 partial, 9 failed, 0 not assessed). NIST Cybersecurity Framework: 12% (1 passed, 0 partial, 10 failed, 0 not assessed). ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A: 0% (0 passed, 0 partial, 10 failed, 0 not assessed). 10 priority-1 gap(s) require immediate attention, notably: CIS-4.1 Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process; CIS-4.4 Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers; CIS-5.4 Restrict Administrator Privileges to Dedicated Administrator Accounts. 30 finding(s) sit in the high-risk zone of the risk matrix.
